info.bio: Azalia Snail is an American avant-garde singer-songwriter and musician. She is a multi-instrumentalist active in psych, folk, and indie rock and played a prominent role in the 1990's lo-fi music scene. She was later dubbed the "Queen of lo-fi". Azalia Snail has recorded 11 critically-acclaimed albums, gaining recognition as a pioneering force in the underground "lo-fi" movement of the 1990's. Many influential labels have released her music, including Sub Pop and Dark Beloved Cloud, who launched their label with a split 7” with Sebadoh. Read more on Last.fm

scenes.name: Cantautoras de los noventa
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: Las mujeres tienen sus propios estilos, en plural: Azalia Snail y su psicodelia lo-fi, Jarboe, Lida Husik (entre la cantante pop y la pintora sonora), Robin Holcomb, Lisa Germano (Geek The Girl, «un viaje dantesco a la psique de una chica»), Tori Amos, Juliana Hatfield, Kristin Hersh, Jewel, Natalie Merchant, Cat Power (Moon Pix), Edith Frost, Lauryn Hill, Shannon Wright. Las «grrrls» más airadas: Lois Maffeo, Ani DiFranco, PJ Harvey (Dry, Rid Of Me), Liz Phair (Exile In Guyville), DQE, Aimee Mann, Sheryl Crow, Alanis Morissette, Neko Case. Y los paisajes sonoros de Björk, la cantautora más influyente de la década, Kate St John, Natacha Atlas, Heather Duby, Solex y Beth Orton.

mentions.text: …of the decade, an eccentric figure of lo-fi psychedelic storyteller emerged out of New York's underground lofts.
